import math

# Rural Electrification Administration securities holdings (in millions)
# From the Treasury Bulletin data for years 1961-1970
values = [11534, 12390, 13599, 13990, 13111, 11768, 10097, 11989, 12115, 12262]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Years: 1961-1970")
print(f"Values (millions $): {values}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print()

# Calculate Theil index of dispersion
# T = (1/n) * Σ [(yi / ȳ) * ln(yi / ȳ)]

for i, v in enumerate(values):
    ratio = v / mean
    term = ratio * math.log(ratio)
    theil_sum += term
    print(f"Year {1961+i}: value={v}, ratio={ratio:.4f}, term={term:.4f}")

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil index of dispersion: {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {theil_index:.3f}")
EOF
